_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: TWO independent reasons this side does not equal the module's stated 7,113.58, and they must not be confused. (1) GRAIN: this filer keeps ONE combined contribution table with a TYPE column, and 15 of its 36 rows are marked 'IK' (in kind), totalling 2,780.20; the 21 monetary rows (CC / CHECK) total 4,875.01, which is the figure claimed here because this module's itemized_contrib_sum is monetary-only (the McKenna 2024 precedent). Combined monetary+in-kind = 7,655.21. (2) FILER ARITHMETIC: the filer's own printed TOTAL - which is also what the cover states - is 7,113.58, i.e. 541.63 LESS than its own rows add to, and 541.63 is exactly the first three ledger lines (1/18/24 $10.46 IK, 1/5/24 $339.46 IK, 1/30 $191.71 IK). So no reconciliation is claimed: stated 7,113.58, monetary itemized 4,875.01, in-kind 2,780.20, combined row sum 7,655.21.

expenditures.detail: 45 rows over pp3-4 summing 4,638.89, equal both to the schedule's own printed TOTAL on p4 and to the cover's stated figure, to the cent. The expense side's SUM range is correct, which is what makes the contribution side's 541.63 shortfall legible as a range error rather than a transcription problem.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: Each schedule prints its OWN bold TOTAL row at the foot of its last page, and each equals the cover figure exactly, so cover and ledger are the same gate on both sides. EXPENSES: the printed TOTAL $4,638.89 on p4 == the cover's 4,638.89, and the 45 transcribed rows sum to 4,638.89 to the cent - a clean close. CONTRIBUTIONS: the printed TOTAL $7,113.58 on p2 == the cover's 7,113.58, but the 36 transcribed rows sum to 7,655.21 (monetary 4,875.01 + in-kind 2,780.20). The residual is 541.63 and it is EXACTLY the first three ledger rows (10.46 + 339.46 + 191.71 = 541.63), i.e. the filer's own TOTAL omits the top three lines of its own table - the signature of a spreadsheet SUM range that starts one block below the first data row. Both figures are named and no repair was made. Escalated twice at 900 dpi (tight crops of the top four contribution rows and of the TOTAL row) purely to confirm the glyphs; both crops reproduced the full-page read, so the difference is the FILER'S arithmetic, not a transcription error - and per the Rhodes ruling the document's own arithmetic, not a re-read, is what settles it.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: NOT THE COUNTY FORM. Pages 2-4 are the filer's OWN two-column spreadsheet (CONTRIBUTIONS: DATE | CONTRIBUTOR | AMOUNT | TYPE; EXPENSES: DATE | NAME | PURPOSE | AMOUNT), printed to PDF born-digital, so there are no specimen rows, no address or city column anywhere, and no <=$50 aggregate box. donor_city / donor_state are therefore honestly BLANK for STRUCTURAL reasons on every row - nothing was redacted by the county and nothing was left empty by the filer; the sheet simply has no place to write it. A TYPE column is a source property this brief did not anticipate: it distinguishes IK (in kind), CC (credit card) and CHECK, and it is the ONLY thing marking in-kind on this filing - there is no separate in-kind schedule and no separate in-kind total, so unlike McKenna 2024 the in-kind money is folded into the single printed contribution TOTAL. The 15 IK rows are all the candidate's own (TORY WELCH), ten of them an identical recurring $191.71 on the 29th of each month from 1/30 through 10/29. Two of them tie directly to expense lines: 1/5 $339.46 IK against 1/5/24 COUNTY CLERK FILING FEE $339.46, and 2/8 $1.00 CC against 2/8 CAMPAIGN TEST $1.00 (a card test). DATES: the filer wrote the year only on the two January lines that carry '/24'; every other cell is a bare month/day, so 34 of 36 contribution rows and 44 of 45 expense rows carry date='' + needs_review=1 with the verbatim in the row note, per the strict-date rule and the 23015 / 24232 precedent - no year is ever completed from the report period. Contribution rows 1 and 2 are also out of date order (1/18 above 1/5), consistent with lines inserted above the original top of the table. GEOMETRY: p2's printed rules are detected cleanly (38 bands, uniform 1.99% pitch) so contribution rows are MEASURED. On p4 the detector splits each printed row into halves (9 bands for 4 rows), so the expenditure side uses a DECLARED frame - y0=6.75, pitch=1.9886, x=24.70, w=50.70 - which was validated against p3's own 43 measured bands (it reproduces detected band 3 at 10.73 and band 43 at 90.27) and spot-verified by crop on both pages: p3 band 43 re-reads as '9/24 EXXON DRINKS $16.96' and p4 band 3 as '10/9 AMAZON SIGN POSTS $48.21'. Two long vendor names are visually clipped by their cell on the rendered page ('BLUSHING TIMBE', 'SIGNS ON THE C') but are complete in the PDF's own text layer and are recorded in full. The cover states current_report and cumulative_total as the SAME numbers, so no period-vs-cumulative question arises on this filing.
